Project Name: INCRED Financial Services Ltd (FLDG Partnership) Duration: June 2021 – Aug 2022 Role: Senior Software Engineer (Applied AI & Backend Research) Project Objective: To automate the personal loan origination process by integrating AI-driven credit evaluation, document understanding, and risk profiling using transformer-based NLP and backend microservices. Responsibilities: • Led R&D and backend development to automate personal loan applications, integrating credit bureaus
(CIBIL, Equifax, Experian) for real-time borrower credit evaluation.
Fetching credit information from different credit beuro (CIBIL, EQUIFAX and Experian) and analysis and assessing reports using PreTrained Distil-BERT model.
Designed and fine-tuned BERT Base and DistilBERT models to extract and classify key financial entities (income, liabilities, PAN/Aadhaar data) from user-submitted documents.
Built a document intelligence pipeline combining Google OCR, BERT embeddings, and semantic similarity models for loan processing(Loan amount and Eligibility calculating).
Developed AI-driven creditworthiness scoring models and decision trees for FLDG lending risk assessment, enhancing underwriting precision.
Experimented with GPT-2 and T5 for text summarization and synthetic data generation to augment limited labeled datasets in loan application scenarios.
Created scalable RESTful microservices using Python (Django REST Framework) to orchestrate document parsing, NLP inference, and credit scoring workflows.
Conducted research on transformer explainability and feature attribution to ensure compliance with financial transparency regulations.
Deployed and optimized AI models on AWS EC2 and Lambda, reducing response latency by over 40% for real-time credit assessments.
Collaborated with cross-functional data and credit teams to align ML model outcomes with business rules and improve loan approval accuracy.
Tools & Technologies: Python, Django REST Framework, BERT Base, DistilBERT, GPT-2, T5, Hugging Face Transformers, AWS EC2, Lambda, Google OCR, Pandas, NumPy, Postman, GitHub

fine-tuned custom BERT architectures using PyTorch to extract structured information from aircraft manuals, maintenance logs, and technical bulletins.
